metadata.title: A Power-Diagram Upper Bound for Twenty-Six Variable-Radius Disks in a Square
metadata.abstract: Let $S_{26}$ denote the supremum of the sum of the radii of 26 pairwise interior-disjoint closed disks of positive radius contained in the unit square. We prove $2.635983084917607783\ldots \le S_{26}\le \sqrt{\frac{2577}{2500}+\frac{11}{\sqrt3}}=2.716919756099889566\ldots$. The lower bound is accompanied by an exact rational feasibility certificate. For the upper bound, we assign the disks their clipped power cells, convert cell area into a reciprocal exterior-angle cost, and combine this local inequality with Euler side counts. The extremal case for the resulting relaxation has four boundary transitions and a four-cell boundary cycle; its continuous angle allocation is reduced to a concave one-variable problem. All finite numerical inequalities are rigorously enclosed by a reproducible certificate. The argument does not determine $S_{26}$ exactly, but gives a nontrivial global upper bound for a benchmark whose best-known packing is asymmetric.
metadata.comment: 15 pages, 1 figure; exact rational feasibility and upper-bound verification scripts and data included as ancillary source files

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对单位正方形内26个正半径、内部互不相交圆盘，给出半径总和的范围2.635983084917607783…≤S₂₆≤2.716919756099889566…。下界用50位十进制作为精确有理数核查429个包含及不交约束；上界以clipped power cell包含对应圆盘，将外角倒数成本转成面积，配合Euler边数及四角边界transition预算求得。
techniques: 有理与外向舍入区间证书
analysis.breakthrough: 将原面积Cauchy–Schwarz上界2.876813…降至2.716919…，消去旧上下界间隙约66.4%。
analysis.limitations: 未求出S₂₆精确值，认证差距仍约0.08094；上下界构造与证明独立。对象是变半径圆盘的半径和，不是等半径圆盘最大半径问题。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第 14 页的 LLM 命中属于引用他人优化研究；未发现作者自身 AI 使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 有限圆盘装填的全局上界与认证构造。
